subject: computer-science

items.misconception: Permanently stores all the computer's files.
items.random_wrong: Connects the computer to the internet.
items.why: The CPU executes instructions; files live on storage; the network card handles connections.

items.q: How do RAM and storage differ?
items.correct: RAM is fast, volatile working memory; storage keeps data without power.
items.random_wrong: RAM keeps its contents when the power is off.
items.why: RAM loses data on power-off (volatile); SSD/HDD storage is non-volatile but slower.

items.q: What is system software like an operating system for?
items.correct: Managing hardware and running other software.
items.misconception: Doing the user's tasks like writing essays.
items.why: The OS manages memory, processes, files and devices; applications do the user's tasks.
